title: Rizia/Turn 10/DEFAULT GATHERING SCENE/DEFAULT HOUSE SAZON CONVO

3.speaker: Leona Sazon
3.text: "Your Majesty. I hope the Queen Mother is happy with her gifts?"

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "Don't act so modest. You know that House Sazon brought the greatest gift of all."

5.speaker: Player_Romus
5.text: "It isn't my mother you need to worry about appeasing, Countess."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "The only gift that would make her happy is a time machine. Would you happen to have one of those?"

7.speaker: Player_Romus
7.text: "She's even happier that all three Sazons came to pay their respects."

8.speaker: Narrator
8.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true

10.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
10.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true

11.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
11.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true) == false

12.speaker: Narrator
12.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.SuOmina_OrderedToKillManus"] == true) == false

13.speaker: Leona Sazon
13.text: "I wish. There are many things we Sazons wish we'd done differently."

17.speaker: Leona Sazon
17.text: "It was the least we could do."

25.speaker: Angelica Sazon
25.text: "It's all his fault. My poor, deluded son and his talk of reform..."

26.speaker: Angelica Sazon
26.text: "He started a fire that now threatens to devour us all."

27.speaker: Leona Sazon
27.text: "My idealistic cousin and his dreams of reform..."

28.speaker: Leona Sazon
28.text: "He started a fire that might end up devouring us all."

40.speaker: Angelica Sazon
40.text: "He started a fire that he won't be able to put out."

44.speaker: Leona Sazon
44.text: "I worry he started a fire he won't be able to put out."

45.speaker: Angelica Sazon
45.text: "Is that so? Because as far as your so-called movement is concerned, you're invisible."

46.speaker: Leona Sazon
46.text: "I'm sorry, Manus. But how could you have let it come to this?"

47.speaker: Leona Sazon
47.text: "Now, Angelica. I'm sure he never meant to let it to come to this."

48.speaker: Leona Sazon
48.text: "I know in my heart that he never meant to let it come to this."

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "Let it come to what? The downtrodden people of Rizia finally speaking up for their beliefs?"

53.speaker: Player_Romus
53.text: "Yes. In a way, it's good that he's not around to see what's become of his movement."

55.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
55.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true

56.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
56.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true) == false

60.speaker: Player_Romus
60.text: "He's the one leading the charge. This is exactly what he wanted."

61.speaker: Angelica Sazon
61.text: "How could you have let it come to this?"

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Angelica came up to stand beside her.

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: "This is as far as it goes. The reformists don't represent the real soul of Rizia."

67.speaker: Player_Romus
67.text: "How do you know? Have you been communicating with him?"
67.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ThreatenToLeave"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_ConvinceToLeave"] == true

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "Regardless of how it came to this, the question is, what do we do next?"

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "None of what's happening is Manus' fault. He tried his best to keep the radicals in line."

70.speaker: Narrator
70.text: Manus looked at me and subtly shook his head.

71.speaker: Angelica Sazon
71.text: "Your Majesty, I am immensely grateful for everything you've done for me."

72.speaker: Player_Romus
72.text: "He had Lucas Sazon's blood. I never did trust him."

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: Manus opened his mouth as if to contradict me, then thought better of it.

79.speaker: Leona Sazon
79.text: "I've sympathized with the reform movement in the past. In fact, I myself voted for the RPP in the last two elections!"

80.speaker: Leona Sazon
80.text: "But the change they are asking for should happen in dialogue with the Crown and the nobility. It can't simply be forced."

81.speaker: Angelica Sazon
81.text: "But I did not return from three decades of exile just to watch my beloved homeland turn into a circus of upheaval yet again."

82.speaker: Manus Sazon
82.text: "I agree it's gotten out of hand. But with Mr. Sotelato no longer leading the movement, I have a chance to turn down the temperature."

86.speaker: Manus Sazon
86.text: "I had hoped to prevent the situation from escalating. But Mr. Sotelato and his Malenyevist backers were too powerful."
86.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true)

90.speaker: Manus Sazon
90.text: "The movement isn't as radical as you think. If our calls for reform were to succeed, the new system wouldn't differ significantly from the old one."
90.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_Arrested"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Adarfo_AssassinationOrdered"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Leader_Adarfo"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true)

92.speaker: Angelica Sazon
92.text: "Your Majesty, I am immensely grateful for everything you've done for me."

96.speaker: Leona Sazon
96.text: "I've sympathized with the reform movement in the past. In fact, I myself voted for the RPP in the last two elections!"

97.speaker: Angelica Sazon
97.text: "But I did not return from three decades of exile just to watch my beloved homeland turn into a circus of upheaval yet again."

98.speaker: Narrator
98.text: She eyed him for a moment.

102.speaker: Angelica Sazon
102.text: "Regardless, I trust the Crown not to capitulate."

107.speaker: Leona Sazon
107.text: "I only hope it's not too late."

111.speaker: Angelica Sazon
111.text: "It's too late for that, my dear. Or have you been ignoring what's taking place outside these very windows?"

118.speaker: Leona Sazon
118.text: "They do seem to have calmed down in the last months. I hope it will stay that way."

119.speaker: Angelica Sazon
119.text: "Malenyevist or not, it makes no difference."

120.speaker: Angelica Sazon
120.text: "The monsters have been uncaged, and they're out for blood yet again."

124.speaker: Leona Sazon
124.text: "I only hope it's not too late to rein them in."

128.speaker: Angelica Sazon
128.text: "You should hear what they're shouting about us at Iza University. It's almost as bad as when your cousin was in charge."

129.speaker: Leona Sazon
129.text: "None of us even dare to set foot in Iza anymore. The city's a separatist republic in all but name."

133.speaker: Leona Sazon
133.text: "We don't want to resort to mass arrests like in Iza, but nor do we want the Brenas leadership to be steamrolled."
133.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_Council_Brenas"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_Outcome_MaxOppression"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_Police"] == true)

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "That's why I'm talking to you right now. We can't stop the next uprising without House Sazon's assistance."

138.speaker: Leona Sazon
138.text: "Judging by the crowds gathered here tonight, Rizia may be at a tipping point."

139.speaker: Leona Sazon
139.text: "The capital seems free of chaos, at least. I hope it will stay that way."

140.speaker: Angelica Sazon
140.text: "Especially now that the chaos has reached a boiling point."

147.speaker: Leona Sazon
147.text: "The crowds outside don't seem like they're calling for slight reforms."

148.speaker: Leona Sazon
148.text: "But with Manus gone, it's turned ugly. House Sazon cannot condone what's been happening."

151.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
151.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_Outcome_MaxOppression"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_Police"] == true) == false

152.speaker: Leona Sazon
152.text: "You should hear some of the things they're shouting at Iza University..."
152.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_Council_Brenas"] == true) == false) and (((Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_None"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_Outcome_MaxOppression"] == true)  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Iza_PowerTransfer_Police"] == true) == false)

159.speaker: Player_Romus
159.text: "I'm as worried as you are. Just listen to what's going on outside."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "You're overreacting. The worst of the unrest has passed."
163.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true)

164.speaker: Player_Romus
164.text: "You're completely overreacting. The movement will fizzle out any day now."
164.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) == false)

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "I share your concerns, but I don't see what it is you want me to do."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Brenas and House Sazon started this mess. You must clean it up."

167.speaker: Angelica Sazon
167.text: "It is too late for anything but the most dramatic of actions."

171.speaker: Leona Sazon
171.text: "He writes from the front now and again."

175.speaker: Leona Sazon
175.text: "At first he was outraged that you shut down the House of Delegates. But he's come to see it as a necessary move."

176.speaker: Leona Sazon
176.text: "He's strongly against what Adarfo Sotelato did with the RPP. In fact, he no longer seems interested in reform at all."

177.speaker: Leona Sazon
177.text: "He writes from Kyrute now and again."

181.speaker: Leona Sazon
181.text: "He was outraged at the closure of the House of Delegates, but is worried about what the RPP has turned into now that it's gone underground."

182.speaker: Leona Sazon
182.text: "He still believes in the need for reform, but he's strongly against what Adarfo Sotelato has done with his party."

186.speaker: Leona Sazon
186.text: "I'm worried that a peaceful resolution to all this is no longer possible."

193.speaker: Angelica Sazon
193.text: "I trust the Crown not to capitulate."

197.speaker: Angelica Sazon
197.text: "We cannot let ourselves become complacent. As long as the movement exists, there is the threat of an uprising."

200.speaker: Leona Sazon
200.text: "It does seem calm here in the capital. Perhaps there's no need for dramatic action."

202.speaker: Player_Romus
202.text: "Your trust will be rewarded, Angelica. I must say, I never expected you to be such a loyal ally."

203.speaker: Angelica Sazon
203.text: "I had to redeem myself somehow, didn't I, Your Majesty?"

204.speaker: Angelica Sazon
204.text: "I wasn't even 20 when I married Lucas. We started sneaking into underground meetings together, drawing up plots to liberate Rizia from the tyranny of the Crown. It was all so thrilling... romantic, even."

205.speaker: Angelica Sazon
205.text: "But when he started planning your abduction, I realized he was willing to put his fantasies of revolution before the safety of his own family."

210.speaker: Angelica Sazon
210.text: "That isn't brave or noble. It's selfish."

215.speaker: Angelica Sazon
215.text: "Something I hope you'll keep in mind when you have a family of your own."

216.speaker: Angelica Sazon
216.text: "Something my own son has yet to understand."

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "You really have changed since the 1920s, haven't you, Angelica?"

222.speaker: Narrator
222.text: Leona gave a nod of understanding.

226.speaker: Angelica Sazon
226.text: "There's nothing brave or noble about the mob outside. They're a group of selfish people, doing this for their own selfish reasons."

230.speaker: Player_Romus
230.text: "Yet another reason why the Sazons must join with the Crown and the other royal houses to destroy them."

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "Don't you think that ending the unrest and bringing peace back to Rizia is of paramount importance, even if it means compromising with the rioters?"

233.speaker: Angelica Sazon
233.text: "Don't be naive. These people would murder us all if given half the chance."

234.speaker: Leona Sazon
234.text: "But only if they truly are willing to compromise."

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: She folded her arms and was silent.

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: I saw a spark in Angelica's eyes.

248.speaker: Angelica Sazon
248.text: "This was why you brought me back, wasn't it? You knew the others would be too weak to rally House Sazon to your side."

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "Selfishness is clinging to wealth and power at the expense of the less fortunate. It's what nobles like us have been doing for centuries."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "I agree that Lucas Sazon should never have acted as rashly as he did. That doesn't mean his ideals weren't worth believing in."

252.speaker: Angelica Sazon
252.text: "The Sazons have given far more wealth to Rizia than we've taken. Where do those ungrateful students in Iza think their university buildings come from?"

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "Don't you think it would save us a great deal of grief to compromise with the reformists, rather than live in constant fear of another uprising?"
253.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true)

254.speaker: Angelica Sazon
254.text: "Don't be naive. I had contact with their circles in the 1920s. These people don't do things by half measures."

255.speaker: Leona Sazon
255.text: "It would. But only if they are truly willing to compromise."

264.speaker: Narrator
264.text: She folded her arms and was silent.

265.speaker: Leona Sazon
265.text: "It's not my intention to stand in the way of progress. If it comes down to it, I will support reforms."

269.speaker: Leona Sazon
269.text: "Especially if Manus is the one behind them."

270.speaker: Leona Sazon
270.text: "Though it would be easier if Manus was the one behind them."

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "Some of them have families as well. They're trying to give them a better future."

273.speaker: Angelica Sazon
273.text: "And they think they can do that by reducing their homeland to ruins?"

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "What's selfish is to refuse to compromise with them, even when doing so could save lives."

275.speaker: Player_Romus
275.text: "I know you still harbor anger towards Lucas. But not all revolutionaries are like him."

276.speaker: Angelica Sazon
276.text: "From what I've seen and heard, most are worse."

277.speaker: Angelica Sazon
277.text: "I have walked among these circles, Your Majesty. Compromise is not a language they speak."

279.speaker: Angelica Sazon
279.text: "His ideals of destroying the monarchy? Your Majesty, I hesitate to think what you're implying right now."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "Manus isn't anything like his father. He believes in improving the system we have, not tearing it down."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "I am glad you've come to understand the error of your former ways. You are a credit to your house."

285.speaker: Manus Sazon
285.text: "Both of us want to keep Father's mistakes from being repeated, Mother. The longer we keep the status quo, the greater the chances another Lucas Sazon will arise. Or worse."

293.speaker: Narrator
293.text: Manus swiveled his head to look around the room.

294.speaker: Manus Sazon
294.text: "Much appreciated, my cousin. But please don't say a word about this until the time is right."

295.speaker: Player_Romus
295.text: "They aren't monsters. They can be reasoned with."

296.speaker: Angelica Sazon
296.text: "You don't know them like I do."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "Let's change the subject. Such topics are unpleasant to discuss on the Queen Mother's birthday."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "I will end the unrest and bring peace to the kingdom. Just trust me on this."

303.speaker: Leona Sazon
303.text: "I agree. Leave the politics talk to another time."

304.speaker: Narrator
304.text: Leona and Angelica exchanged uneasy looks.

309.speaker: Narrator
309.text: Leona gave me an uneasy look.

315.speaker: Narrator
315.text: I saw uncertainty in Leona's eyes.

316.speaker: Leona Sazon
316.text: "Who was the one holding Brenas together while you and Manus were away? Don't I deserve the slightest bit of credit?"

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: Manus wasn't listening to either of them. He turned towards me.

321.speaker: Manus Sazon
321.text: "Your Majesty, is it really your plan to use the nobility to stomp out dissent? Because if it is, I have serious objections."

325.speaker: Manus Sazon
325.text: "Does Vina know? She'd never agree to such a thing--"

329.speaker: Narrator
329.text: Leona politely but firmly cut him off.

333.speaker: Leona Sazon
333.text: "This isn't your decision to make, Manus. It's your mother's."

334.speaker: Leona Sazon
334.text: "I was the one holding our house together while you and Angelica were in exile. This isn't your decision to make."

336.speaker: Leona Sazon
336.text: "You may stand with House Sazon, or get out of our way."

337.speaker: Leona Sazon
337.text: "I am with you, Your Majesty, but there is a limit to what House Sazon can do."

338.speaker: Leona Sazon
338.text: "Manus could have inspired the families of Brenas to take action, but without him..."

342.speaker: Leona Sazon
342.text: "Need I remind you that our heir -- and our most persuasive member -- is a reformist himself?"

343.speaker: Narrator
343.text: The uncertainty began to give way to resolve.

344.speaker: Leona Sazon
344.text: "The only way we'll stand a chance, Your Majesty, is if you bring back the head of our house."

345.speaker: Leona Sazon
345.text: "Angelica. End her exile, and she will rally House Sazon to your side."

349.speaker: Manus Sazon
349.text: "I wish the same, my cousin. But the rest of my party has spoken."

350.speaker: Manus Sazon
350.text: "Your support is much appreciated. But please don't say a word about this until the time is right."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "I will hold you to your word, Leona. I promise Brenas will be better off in the end."

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "Let's change the subject, shall we? Wouldn't want the other nobles in the room getting wind of this conversation."

354.speaker: Player_Romus
354.text: "I count on your discretion going forward. We will act on this very soon."

356.speaker: Leona Sazon
356.text: "And I will hold you to that promise, Your Majesty."

357.speaker: Leona Sazon
357.text: "I won't tell a soul, Your Majesty."

358.speaker: Player_Romus
358.text: "The reform movement is the least pressing issue facing Rizia today. Let's not dwell on it."

361.speaker: Angelica Sazon
361.text: "You have done a fine job, Leona. But alone, you don't have what it takes to quell an uprising. I am only stating the facts."

363.speaker: Angelica Sazon
363.text: "We and Brenas are with you. We will end this nonsense and restore dignity to Rizia."

367.speaker: Angelica Sazon
367.text: "House Sazon is with you, Your Majesty. But you must remember that we still lack authority after the events of the last half-century..."

368.speaker: Angelica Sazon
368.text: "If you were to reconsider your decision to centralize the Zille region, we could amass the strength necessary to defeat the revolution."

369.speaker: Angelica Sazon
369.text: "The trust you've displayed in House Sazon over the past few years has been nothing less than miraculous, Your Majesty."

370.speaker: Angelica Sazon
370.text: "Granting my pardon, bringing Zille back to us..."

371.speaker: Player_Romus
371.text: "The traitor? Never. She will die on Caleqabiz."

372.speaker: Player_Romus
372.text: "I will do whatever it takes to win this. Tell your cousin that her banishment is over."

373.speaker: Player_Romus
373.text: "How can you guarantee that she will do as I ask? That she doesn't still resent the Crown for punishing her?"

374.speaker: Leona Sazon
374.text: "We have spoken many times, Your Majesty. Set her free, and I guarantee she will be a loyal ally."

375.speaker: Player_Romus
375.text: "It's been over 30 years. Does Brenas even remember her?"

376.speaker: Leona Sazon
376.text: "Even from exile, she commands the hearts of our province."

379.speaker: Leona Sazon
379.text: "Remember, she was the one who handed in Lucas Sazon to your father. Her own husband!"

380.speaker: Player_Romus
380.text: "She was saving her own skin. That hardly counts as loyalty."

381.speaker: Player_Romus
381.text: "It does take courage to commit such an act. Especially as a young woman."

382.speaker: Player_Romus
382.text: "All that says to me is that she is capable of lying and treachery, even against those she loves."

383.speaker: Narrator
383.text: The Countess put a hand to her heart in astonishment.

384.speaker: Leona Sazon
384.text: "First Zille, now this... the rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

388.speaker: Leona Sazon
388.text: "The rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

389.speaker: Leona Sazon
389.text: "And when Manus returns home from the war, we will be fully whole."

391.speaker: Player_Romus
391.text: "The heir to House Sazon, one of Rizia's proudest of noble families."

392.speaker: Player_Romus
392.text: "Manus, don't forget that you and Vina are set to inherit the throne. Defeat the revolution, and the two of you can steer Rizia in whatever direction you want."

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "The time for toying around with democratic ideals is over. Now man up and claim your birthright."

397.speaker: Player_Romus
397.text: "It's your fault this movement has grown as large as it has. By order of the King, you will help fix this."

398.speaker: Player_Romus
398.text: "You still care for Vina, don't you? The revolutionaries will never let her live."

399.speaker: Player_Romus
399.text: "Forget it, madam. Manus doesn't have the spine to defend his house or his king."

400.speaker: Angelica Sazon
400.text: "She's right, son. You will stand with House Sazon, or you'll get out of the way."

401.speaker: Manus Sazon
401.text: "The Palesians may kill her anyway, thanks to her father placing her in harm's way."

408.speaker: Manus Sazon
408.text: "Her Highness is already out of harm's way. Out of this cage of a country."

409.speaker: Manus Sazon
409.text: "Her Highness should decide for herself whether Rizia is to be defended in such a manner."

410.speaker: Manus Sazon
410.text: "Are you sure about that, Your Majesty? Another heir is coming, after all."

414.speaker: Manus Sazon
414.text: "Can you guarantee me that Her Highness will still be first in line for the throne, no matter the sex of your child-to-be?"

416.speaker: Manus Sazon
416.text: "If you will not do anything to jeopardize that inheritance... then I suppose I have no choice."

417.speaker: Manus Sazon
417.text: "Whatever it is you're planning, I want no part in it."

421.speaker: Player_Romus
421.text: "No, I can't guarantee that. I promised House Azaro that if the child is male, he will be my successor. But there's only a 50 percent chance that will happen."

422.speaker: Player_Romus
422.text: "I cannot. If Vina's younger sibling is a boy, he will be my successor. Those are the rules."

424.speaker: Narrator
424.text: He glared at me in obvious offense.

425.speaker: Manus Sazon
425.text: "What kind of a man do you think I am, Your Majesty?"

426.speaker: Player_Romus
426.text: "The Crown Prince Consort and a member of the Royal Family. Defending the Crown is part of that package."

427.speaker: Angelica Sazon
427.text: "A very good question. I share my son's curiosity."

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "Yes. You have my word that no matter what happens, you will remain the Crown Prince Consort of Rizia."

432.speaker: Player_Romus
432.text: "Why is everyone so fixated on my unborn child's genitals? Frankly, it's disgusting."

434.speaker: Manus Sazon
434.text: "I too find it peculiar that such a minor feature should dictate one's inheritance."

438.speaker: Player_Romus
438.text: "The sex of Lucita's child makes no difference. Vina is my firstborn. She deserves the throne."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "Rules are meant to be broken. I will make sure that as my firstborn, Vina succeeds me."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "Regardless, tradition is tradition. If the child is a boy, I will have no choice but to make him my successor."

444.speaker: Manus Sazon
444.text: "Then... I am with you, Your Majesty."

446.speaker: Manus Sazon
446.text: "Please, Your Majesty. You know perfectly well what I mean."

447.speaker: Leona Sazon
447.text: "Just answer his question, Your Majesty. Can you promise that Her Highness Princess Vina will succeed you?"

449.speaker: Manus Sazon
449.text: "A Rizia under Azaro rule will hardly be better off than one under the revolutionaries."

451.speaker: Narrator
451.text: He scowled and walked off to join Vina.

455.speaker: Narrator
455.text: He scowled and walked off to talk to other guests.

464.speaker: Manus Sazon
464.text: "I suppose I knew I would have to make a choice like this after marrying Vina."

465.speaker: Manus Sazon
465.text: "Am I still the Crown Prince Consort? Another heir is coming, after all."

466.speaker: Player_Romus
466.text: "A man who does as his King commands."

467.speaker: Manus Sazon
467.text: "I'm sorry. I'm not going to stand around and listen to this talk."

468.speaker: Player_Romus
468.text: "Until you have taken up arms to protect your kingdom, you are no man at all."

469.speaker: Manus Sazon
469.text: "Your Majesty, if you had only listened to me years ago, none of this would be happening."

471.speaker: Player_Romus
471.text: "Leona? Angelica? Are you still with me?"

477.speaker: Player_Romus
477.text: "We don't need him, anyway. Right, ladies?"

478.speaker: Player_Romus
478.text: "It will be difficult to do this without Manus, but I know the rest of House Sazon has the strength to aid me."

479.speaker: Player_Romus
479.text: "We don't need him anyway. Am I right?"

480.speaker: Player_Romus
480.text: "It will be difficult to do this without Manus, but I know the rest of House Sazon has the strength to aid me."

486.speaker: Angelica Sazon
486.text: "If we had reclaimed our ancestral lands in Zille, perhaps we could amass the strength necessary to defeat the revolution."

489.speaker: Player_Romus
489.text: "Zille has yet to recover from the effects of the Wehlen occupation. You want to destabilize it further?"

490.speaker: Player_Romus
490.text: "You think the people of Zille will help? They're hardly even Rizians."

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "Very well. Stand with us against the revolutionaries, and I will gladly return Zille into your house's hands."

492.speaker: Player_Romus
492.text: "I see. You never forgave my family for taking Zille away from you."

493.speaker: Angelica Sazon
493.text: "We would not be destabilizing the province. We would be uniting it under its former banner."

495.speaker: Angelica Sazon
495.text: "Among those who remember life under Rizian rule, loyalty to House Sazon has not faded."

503.speaker: Player_Romus
503.text: "Do not forget that it was I, Romus Toras, who stopped the recent unrest in its tracks. I expect nothing but gratitude from your house."
503.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true)

505.speaker: Player_Romus
505.text: "Nobody would dare go against the will of God's messenger on Earth."
505.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true)

510.speaker: Player_Romus
510.text: "I am less troubled by the commoners' protests than I am by the specter of dissent within the nobility."

511.speaker: Player_Romus
511.text: "Do not forget that it is I, Romus Toras, who keeps this kingdom safe from unrest. I expect nothing but gratitude from your house."
511.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Unrest_NatDes_Happened"] == true) == false)

512.speaker: Leona Sazon
512.text: "Such a prospect horrifies us as well, Your Majesty."

515.speaker: Leona Sazon
515.text: "She was risking her own life. She didn't know what punishment awaited her."

516.speaker: Leona Sazon
516.text: "She did it for the sake of her child. And for the sake of her kingdom."

517.speaker: Leona Sazon
517.text: "She realized that a movement that would ask her to risk the life of her child was not one worth fighting for."

518.speaker: Player_Romus
518.text: "I am moved by your love for your cousin. If you truly do vouch for her loyalty, I will end her exile."

519.speaker: Player_Romus
519.text: "I am not convinced. Angelica will remain in Caleqabiz."

522.speaker: Angelica Sazon
522.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I and my house are in your debt."

526.speaker: Leona Sazon
526.text: "In spite of all my cousin's efforts to undermine us."

527.speaker: Player_Romus
527.text: "If she could turn on her husband like that, she could turn on her King. She cannot be trusted."

529.speaker: Leona Sazon
529.text: "Her sacrifice on behalf of the Crown was a memorable act indeed."

531.speaker: Leona Sazon
531.text: "I warn you, Your Majesty, I am a mere Countess. And my charges in Sallabes are more adept at putting on opera productions than they are at fighting."

532.speaker: Player_Romus
532.text: "Fight the traitors with opera, if you must. Split their heads open with high-frequency arias."

533.speaker: Player_Romus
533.text: "Nonetheless, your willingness to aid the Crown speaks volumes. I will remember this."

534.speaker: Player_Romus
534.text: "You are too modest. I'm counting on Brenas to raise hell."

535.speaker: Player_Romus
535.text: "Don't worry, Leona. I wouldn't ask you to stop the unrest by yourself. I will handle it."

536.speaker: Narrator
536.text: She smiled and wiped her forehead.

538.speaker: Narrator
538.text: She seemed in a daze as she turned away from me, nearly bumping into a server carrying a tray of champagne flutes.

541.speaker: Leona Sazon
541.text: "Still, let us know if our assistance is needed."

542.speaker: Narrator
542.text: Giddy with relief, she turned away from me, nearly bumping into a server carrying a tray of champagne flutes.

545.speaker: Narrator
545.text: I watched her walk away, then looked around at the rest of my guests.

548.speaker: Angelica Sazon
548.text: "The punishment was deserved, Your Majesty. But it's been 30 years."

549.speaker: Angelica Sazon
549.text: "You showed great faith in House Sazon by returning Iza to us. With Zille, all of Brenas will finally be whole again."

553.speaker: Angelica Sazon
553.text: "We Sazons still have the loss of Iza to remind us of the folly of 1926. With Zille, Brenas will be that much closer to being whole again."

554.speaker: Player_Romus
554.text: "All right. After we crush the revolution, Zille will be yours."

556.speaker: Player_Romus
556.text: "My answer is no. You are asking for too much."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "For the sake of preserving safety in the region, I cannot grant your request."

558.speaker: Angelica Sazon
558.text: "Very well. Then we will aid you to the best of our limited ability."

559.speaker: Narrator
559.text: I saw her neck muscles tense.

560.speaker: Angelica Sazon
560.text: "Nonetheless, we will aid you to the best of our limited ability."

562.speaker: Leona Sazon
562.text: "I warn you, Your Majesty, I am a mere Countess. And my charges in Sallabes are more adept at putting on opera productions than they are at fighting."

563.speaker: Player_Romus
563.text: "Fight the traitors with opera, if you must. Split their heads open with high-frequency arias."

564.speaker: Player_Romus
564.text: "Nonetheless, your willingness to aid the Crown speaks volumes. I will remember this."

565.speaker: Player_Romus
565.text: "You are too modest. I'm counting on Brenas to raise hell."

566.speaker: Player_Romus
566.text: "Don't worry, Leona. I wouldn't ask you to stop the unrest by yourself. I will handle it."

567.speaker: Narrator
567.text: She smiled and wiped her forehead.

568.speaker: Narrator
568.text: Angelica took her cousin by the arm and led her away.

571.speaker: Leona Sazon
571.text: "Still, let us know if our assistance is needed."

573.speaker: Angelica Sazon
573.text: "You look pale as a ghost, Leona. Let's get you a drink."

575.speaker: Narrator
575.text: I watched them leave, then looked around at the rest of my guests.

576.speaker: Leona Sazon
576.text: "I warn you, Your Majesty, I am a mere Countess. And my charges in Sallabes are more adept at putting on opera productions than they are at fighting."

580.speaker: Angelica Sazon
580.text: "Leave the organizing to me. Between the Sazons, the Carranzas and the other noble families of Brenas, we'll be able to stop this uprising in its tracks."

581.speaker: Manus Sazon
581.text: "Many of the RPP Delegates from Brenas are still loyal to me, not Adarfo. I'll try to get what information I can from the inside."

588.speaker: Manus Sazon
588.text: "You won't have to act alone, Leona."
588.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_SazonsAgainstUnrest_ManusRefuses"] == false)

589.speaker: Leona Sazon
589.text: "But once Angelica is here, she'll know exactly what to do."
589.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_SazonsAgainstUnrest_ManusRefuses"] == false) == false)

590.speaker: Angelica Sazon
590.text: "A few years ago I never would have imagined I'd see Porte Drazon again, let alone be invited to the Queen Mother's birthday. I am honored and humbled beyond belief, Your Majesty."

594.speaker: Narrator
594.text: Silence descended. After a moment, Leona spoke up brightly.
594.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Movement_Grows"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == false  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true))) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Turn09_TalkWithTitus_PortraitTalk_VisionNormal"] == true) == false)

595.speaker: Leona Sazon
595.text: "I haven't had a chance to congratulate you on your partnership, Your Majesty."

596.speaker: Leona Sazon
596.text: "I was just at a commitment ceremony held by two Golcondist friends of mine -- both men. It was just gorgeous."

598.speaker: Player_Romus
598.text: "A commitment ceremony? When do you think Rizia will be ready for homosexual marriage?"

600.speaker: Player_Romus
600.text: "I am relieved to hear that. I hope all of House Sazon shares your outlook."

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "Thank you, Leona. Sadly, your opinion is a rarity in Rizia."

602.speaker: Leona Sazon
602.text: "I myself would accept it in a heartbeat, but as for the rest of the country... the word 'marriage' still holds a very specific meaning."

603.speaker: Leona Sazon
603.text: "One of the guards at Sallabes Manor is from Derdia. He's so friendly and open... Not like the stereotypes at all."

611.speaker: Player_Romus
611.text: "That was it. The last piece of the puzzle. All three royal houses are on my side."
611.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_SazonsAgainstUnrest_ManusRefuses"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Toras"] == true)

612.speaker: Player_Romus
612.text: "If only it were that easy to get the other houses on my side."
612.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_SazonsAgainstUnrest_ManusRefuses"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Azaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.NatDes_UniteHousesAgainst_Toras"] == true) == false)

613.speaker: Player_Romus
613.text: "Don't underestimate the power of opera, Countess. You can always split our opponents' heads open with high-frequency arias."
613.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_SazonsAgainstUnrest_ManusRefuses"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_FunnyKing"] == true)

617.speaker: Player_Romus
617.text: "I know how much you Sazons value peace. Once we win the war and stop the uprising, we'll never have to worry about violence in our kingdom again."
617.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_SazonsAgainstUnrest_ManusRefuses"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true)

621.speaker: Player_Romus

634.speaker: Angelica Sazon
634.text: "And yet he hasn't spoken against the sizeable majority of his party that believes otherwise."

635.speaker: Leona Sazon
635.text: "It's true. I myself haven't kept a cent of income for the past decade."

636.speaker: Manus Sazon
636.text: "Because doing that as a noble will only enrage them further. I trust the people involved in this movement to regulate it themselves."

637.speaker: Angelica Sazon
637.text: "We do, Your Majesty. All orientations should be welcome under the umbrella of the monarchy."

638.speaker: Narrator
638.text: Silence descended for a moment. Leona spoke up hesitantly.

639.speaker: Leona Sazon
639.text: "We in Brenas are rather concerned about Rizia's new religious direction, Your Majesty."

643.speaker: Leona Sazon
643.text: "The Dastnurist community in particular is concerned about what this change means, after you've been so receptive to their needs in the past."

644.speaker: Leona Sazon
644.text: "In particular, the Dastnurist community feels they are being shut out. Especially since their requests for new places of worship have gone unanswered."

645.speaker: Player_Romus
645.text: "And you care about the opinion of those heathens?"

646.speaker: Player_Romus
646.text: "All they have to do is accept the legitimacy of St. Wruhec's teachings, and they will be more than welcome."

647.speaker: Player_Romus
647.text: "They are Nurists, just like you and me. There will always be a place for them in our kingdom."

648.speaker: Player_Romus
648.text: "I myself have a number of Dastnurists in my life. Their branch of Nurity will always be tolerated here."

652.speaker: Player_Romus
652.text: "If they don't like the change, they are free to go back to their home countries."

653.speaker: Leona Sazon
653.text: "Well... there are quite a large number of them in our province. And most don't have the resources to leave."

654.speaker: Leona Sazon
654.text: "Most of them don't have the resources to leave. Or homes to go back to, for that matter..."

666.speaker: Leona Sazon
666.text: "Most do. The others will come around. Tolerance takes time."

667.speaker: Leona Sazon
667.text: "I only hope your family hasn't taken the news too hard."

668.speaker: Player_Romus
668.text: "House Toras is thrilled. Ticker-tape parades in my honor, things of that nature."

672.speaker: Player_Romus
672.text: "I see right through you. You're just glad Manus and Vina will inherit the throne unchallenged."

673.speaker: Player_Romus
673.text: "That's a very personal matter. I'd rather you didn't pry into it."

674.speaker: Player_Romus
674.text: "I'm under quite a bit of pressure to abdicate, as a matter of fact."

679.speaker: Leona Sazon
679.text: "Oh-- of course not. Sorry I brought it up."

686.speaker: Angelica Sazon
686.text: "What difference does that make, when their children won't bear the Sazon name?"

687.speaker: Angelica Sazon
687.text: "I would hope that would have been the case no matter what."

688.speaker: Leona Sazon
688.text: "Oh, grand. Perhaps my perception of your house was mistaken."

689.speaker: Leona Sazon
689.text: "My goodness. I'm sorry to hear it."

690.speaker: Leona Sazon
690.text: "Of course that's a lovely thought as well. But I am as happy for you as I am for them."

695.speaker: Player_Romus
695.text: "I hope you're prepared to take the throne soon, Manus."

697.speaker: Manus Sazon
697.text: "It is Vina's throne, Your Majesty. Not mine. But thank you."

698.speaker: Player_Romus
698.text: "Let's keep that information between us, though."

702.speaker: Angelica Sazon
702.text: "I believe His Majesty was being sarcastic, Leona."

703.speaker: Manus Sazon
703.text: "Don't think of it that way, Mother. I'll be proud to raise the next heir or heiress of Rizia, no matter the surname."

704.speaker: Leona Sazon
704.text: "Yes, of course. It's none of the rest our our business."

705.speaker: Player_Romus
705.text: "But I will die before I apologize for who I am."

706.speaker: Narrator
706.text: I registered disappointment on the Sazons' faces.

710.speaker: Leona Sazon
710.text: "Your bravery is so inspiring, Your Majesty."

712.speaker: Leona Sazon
712.text: "That will be not be easy, Your Majesty. It's akin to asking you or me to reject those same teachings."

713.speaker: Leona Sazon
713.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I will tell our Dastnurist leaders their King has not overlooked them."

714.speaker: Player_Romus
714.text: "Should I call the Wruhec's Guardians over here? I'm sure they can assuage your doubts."

715.speaker: Player_Romus
715.text: "Trust in God and the wisdom of our Grand Wiseman. This is the best direction for Rizia, non-Wruhecists included."

716.speaker: Player_Romus
716.text: "It is time for them to choose. Their kingdom, or their beliefs."

720.speaker: Player_Romus
720.text: "The members of Su Omina will be able to help with their relocation."

721.speaker: Player_Romus
721.text: "A good. point. The Crown will look into programs to help with their relocation."

726.speaker: Player_Romus
726.text: "You act as if I have done something extreme. I am only making minor adjustments to our government to reflect our existing state religion."

727.speaker: Angelica Sazon
727.text: "The people of Brenas have long valued diversity, Your Majesty..."

729.speaker: Leona Sazon
729.text: "There is no need, Your Majesty. Forgive me."

730.speaker: Angelica Sazon
730.text: "But I see your decision as a measure to bring much-needed unity back to Rizia."

737.speaker: Player_Romus
737.text: "Enough with the genuflecting, Angelica. You're family."

738.speaker: Player_Romus
738.text: "Do not take your freedom for granted, even for a second. Remember that you are only here by my mercy."

739.speaker: Player_Romus
739.text: "You're so polite. Nothing at all like certain junior members of House Sazon."

743.speaker: Player_Romus
743.text: "Do you hear anything from Manus these days?"

921.speaker: Leona Sazon
921.text: "I can't wait until that day comes, Your Majesty."

922.speaker: Leona Sazon
922.text: "He may yet regain that fighting spirit when he returns. If he returns."

923.speaker: Leona Sazon
923.text: "I only hope he has many more years as a Rizian left ahead of him."

924.speaker: Leona Sazon

934.speaker: Narrator

935.speaker: Player_Romus

936.speaker: Player_Romus

939.speaker: Manus Sazon

940.speaker: Player_Romus

1078.speaker: Leona Sazon

1082.speaker: Leona Sazon
1082.text: "The expanded Grandsanctuary was worth every second of labor that went into it. Tourists come to see it from far and wide -- not only Dastnurist ones, either."
1082.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false)

1086.speaker: Leona Sazon
1086.text: "The expansion of the Sallabes Grandsanctuary has had its share of delays, as you know, but I'm sure it will be worth it in the end."
1086.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false)

1088.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1088.text: "And of course, the entire province rejoiced at the marriage between my son and Princess Vina."
1088.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_SallabesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_IzaHeavyIndustry_Completed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)

1089.speaker: Player_Romus
1089.text: "Do not lie to me, Countess. How is everything, really?"
1089.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0)

1090.speaker: Player_Romus
1090.text: "Good. As the highest-ranking Sazon in the region, it's your responsibility to keep your relatives in line."
1090.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0)

1091.speaker: Player_Romus
1091.text: "If there are any problems you'd like to bring up with your King, now is the time."
1091.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0)

1094.speaker: Narrator
1094.text: She raised her eyes to meet mine.

1095.speaker: Leona Sazon
1095.text: "Your Majesty, House Sazon is still struggling from a lack of proper leadership."

1099.speaker: Leona Sazon
1099.text: "Perhaps Manus will reclaim the title of Duke when he returns from war. But for now, we are seeing infighting -- and, dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."
1099.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false)

1103.speaker: Leona Sazon
1103.text: "Without an heir like Manus to unite behind, there has been infighting -- and dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."
1103.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true)

1107.speaker: Leona Sazon
1107.text: "With Manus in opposition to your policies, there has been infighting -- and dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."
1107.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1108.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1108.text: "Your Majesty, I am saddened to report that House Sazon's allegiance to the Crown has begun to falter once more."

1109.speaker: Leona Sazon
1109.text: "Not our own allegiance, of course. But yes."

1113.speaker: Manus Sazon
1113.text: "His Majesty was implying nothing. We can all agree that my father should never have done what he did."

1114.speaker: Narrator
1114.text: Leona readjusted one of her hairpins.

1115.speaker: Leona Sazon
1115.text: "I do tire of this political talk. Shall we change the subject?"

1120.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1120.text: "Or maybe the next Lucas Sazon is already here."

1122.speaker: Leona Sazon
1122.text: "With Manus in the capital most of the time, Brenas is succumbing to infighting -- and, dare I say it, faltering allegiance to the Crown."

1127.speaker: Leona Sazon
1127.text: "It was the very least we could do."

1131.speaker: Leona Sazon
1131.text: "I never would have imagined Brenas as a center of industry, but the growth our industrial production has brought to the economy has been stunning."
1131.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_SallabesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_IzaHeavyIndustry_Completed"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false)

1132.speaker: Leona Sazon
1132.text: "And of course, the entire province rejoiced at the marriage between Manus and Princess Vina."
1132.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_SallabesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_IzaHeavyIndustry_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)

1146.speaker: Leona Sazon
1146.text: "And now the news that Manus might lose his claim to the throne..."
1146.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true)

1147.speaker: Leona Sazon
1147.text: "It's all too much for a Countess such as myself to manage on my own."
1147.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false)

1148.speaker: Leona Sazon
1148.text: "There is but one House Sazon member who could bring order back to Brenas. But she remains on Caleqabiz."

1160.speaker: Leona Sazon
1160.text: "And now the news that Manus might lose his claim to the throne..."
1160.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true)

1161.speaker: Leona Sazon
1161.text: "It is a lot for our house to manage."
1161.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pales_War"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_SuOmina_AlliedToCrown"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false)

1162.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1162.text: "Especially after the disappointment of losing Zille."

1167.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1167.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. That's all we ever wanted."

1169.speaker: Player_Romus
1169.text: "Angelica, the traitor? Never. She will die on that island."

1170.speaker: Player_Romus
1170.text: "Three decades has been long enough. Tell Angelica Sazon that her banishment is over."

1171.speaker: Player_Romus
1171.text: "How can you guarantee that she will do as you claim? That she doesn't still resent the Crown for punishing her?"

1172.speaker: Leona Sazon
1172.text: "We have spoken many times, Your Majesty. Set her free, and I guarantee she will be a loyal ally."

1173.speaker: Player_Romus
1173.text: "It's been over 30 years. Does Brenas even remember her?"

1174.speaker: Leona Sazon
1174.text: "Even from exile, she commands the hearts of our province."

1177.speaker: Leona Sazon
1177.text: "Remember, she was the one who handed in Lucas Sazon to your father. Her own husband!"

1178.speaker: Player_Romus
1178.text: "She was saving her own skin. That hardly counts as loyalty."

1179.speaker: Player_Romus
1179.text: "It does take courage to commit such an act. Especially as a young woman."

1180.speaker: Player_Romus
1180.text: "All that says to me is that she is capable of lying and treachery, even against those she loves."

1181.speaker: Narrator
1181.text: The Countess put a hand to her heart in astonishment.

1182.speaker: Leona Sazon
1182.text: "First Zille, now this... the rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

1186.speaker: Leona Sazon
1186.text: "The rift between our houses truly has begun to heal."

1188.speaker: Leona Sazon
1188.text: "She was risking her own life. She didn't know what punishment awaited her."

1189.speaker: Leona Sazon
1189.text: "She did it for the sake of her child. And for the sake of her kingdom."

1190.speaker: Leona Sazon
1190.text: "She realized that a movement that would ask her to risk the life of her child was not one worth fighting for."

1191.speaker: Player_Romus
1191.text: "I am moved by your love for your cousin. If you truly do vouch for her loyalty, I will end her exile."

1193.speaker: Player_Romus
1193.text: "I am not convinced. Angelica will remain in Caleqabiz."

1194.speaker: Leona Sazon
1194.text: "Her sacrifice on behalf of the Crown was a memorable act indeed."

1196.speaker: Player_Romus
1196.text: "If she could turn on her husband like that, she could turn on her King. She cannot be trusted."

1201.speaker: Manus Sazon
1201.text: "I never would have expected this, Your Majesty. Please accept my gratitude."
1201.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1208.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1208.text: "And of course, we are still indebted to you for arranging my pardon."
1208.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_SallabesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_IzaHeavyIndustry_Completed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false)

1212.speaker: Player_Romus
1212.text: "I trust you, Leona. If you can lead Sallabes, you can bring the other Sazons back to House Toras' side."

1213.speaker: Player_Romus
1213.text: "Tell your peers in Brenas that if any of them dare to speak out against me, they will face the guillotine."

1214.speaker: Player_Romus
1214.text: "However, your fellow Sazons needn't worry about Manus losing his claim to the throne. Vina will remain first in line to succeed me, no matter what."

1218.speaker: Manus Sazon
1218.text: "That's truly incredible to hear. Thank you."

1219.speaker: Narrator
1219.text: She and Manus broke into relieved smiles.

1221.speaker: Player_Romus
1221.text: "It is my pleasure to make your family whole once again."
1221.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1222.speaker: Player_Romus
1222.text: "When she returns, her first duty shall be punishing all those members of your house who dared to speak against me."
1222.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1223.speaker: Player_Romus
1223.text: "And Manus, you needn't worry about losing your claim to the throne. Vina will remain first in line to succeed me, no matter what."

1227.speaker: Player_Romus
1227.text: "I'm sure Hegel was getting sick of a disgraced Rizian noble squatting on his island, anyway."
1227.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_ValgslandCSP"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1234.speaker: Player_Romus
1234.text: "I'm sure Alvarez was getting sick of a disgraced Rizian noble squatting on his island, anyway."
1234.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_ValgslandCSP"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Caleqabiz_LespiaATO"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1235.speaker: Leona Sazon
1235.text: "Angelica did write that the newcomers to the island were giving her angry looks."

1238.speaker: Leona Sazon
1238.text: "We will serve you with honor. Just as we did before 1926."

1239.speaker: Player_Romus
1239.text: "It's nothing personal, Countess. But I can't just go around pardoning everyone for their crimes."

1248.speaker: Player_Romus
1248.text: "Zille has yet to recover from the effects of the Wehlen occupation. You want to destabilize it further?"

1249.speaker: Player_Romus
1249.text: "You think adding several million Wehzeks to your population will bring order to Brenas? I've got news for you."

1250.speaker: Player_Romus
1250.text: "Why not? That was only a transitory measure anyway. Zille is yours."

1251.speaker: Player_Romus
1251.text: "I see.  You never forgave my family for taking Zille away from you."

1252.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1252.text: "We would not be destabilizing the province. We would be uniting it under its former banner."

1253.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1253.text: "Not Wehzeks any longer, Your Majesty. Rizians."

1255.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1255.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I and my house are forever in your debt."

1256.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1256.text: "Zille was taken from all of Brenas, even from those who didn't participate in the uprising."

1257.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1257.text: "You showed great faith in House Sazon by returning Iza to us. With Zille, all of Brenas will finally be whole again."

1258.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1258.text: "We Sazons still have the loss of Iza to remind us of the folly of 1926. With Zille, our province will be that much closer to being whole again."

1263.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1263.text: "On the other hand, if you were to reconsider your decision to centralize the region..."

1267.speaker: Player_Romus
1267.text: "If that is what your house truly wants, then I will grant your request. I will reverse my decision and arrange for the integration of Zille into Brenas."

1268.speaker: Player_Romus
1268.text: "That was not the outcome any of us wanted. I sympathize with your house, but there is nothing I can do."

1269.speaker: Player_Romus
1269.text: "Do you want my royal advice? Get over it. Move on. The rest of us have."

1270.speaker: Player_Romus
1270.text: "I am surprised that House Sazon's loyalty is so conditional, Angelica. Especially after the events of the 1920s."

1271.speaker: Player_Romus
1271.text: "Had it been up to me, Zille would have been yours again by now."

1272.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1272.text: "I am surprised as well, Your Majesty. I have told the others their concerns are unfounded."

1275.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1275.text: "Yes, I know. None of us could have anticipated Wiktor Smolak's actions."

1279.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1279.text: "But sacrificing Zille to regain Pales? It sends a rather strong message to those of us in Brenas."

1280.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1280.text: "A joy undimmed by the news of your second heir. Congratulations on that, by the way."

1281.speaker: Leona Sazon
1281.text: "A joy undimmed by the news of a second heir to the throne. Congratulations on that, by the way, Your Majesty."

1282.speaker: Player_Romus
1282.text: "And Manus, you needn't worry about losing your claim to the throne. Vina will remain first in line to succeed me, no matter what."

1287.speaker: Player_Romus
1287.text: "I understand your frustrations, but I vow that your patience will be rewarded one day."

1288.speaker: Player_Romus
1288.text: "I am warning you. Not another word, or you'll be sent back to Caleqabiz."

1289.speaker: Player_Romus
1289.text: "Here is what I can offer. Your son and my daughter will succeed me as monarchs of Rizia. No matter what."
1289.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_WehlenJoined"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true)

1293.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1293.text: "That would be wonderful news, Your Majesty."

1294.speaker: Player_Romus
1294.text: "Your son and my daughter are set to succeed me after I die. Isn't that enough consolation for your house?"
1294.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.War_WehlenJoined"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true)

1301.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1301.text: "I am sorry. Let's not dwell on this any longer."

1302.speaker: Player_Romus
1302.text: "I am looking out for the kingdom as a whole, not only your house. I sincerely believe that Zille's reintegration will be more successful if it is overseen by the central government."

1304.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1304.text: "Understood. I will question you no further."

1305.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1305.text: "As long as they keep the throne they are given."

1307.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1307.text: "As long as they keep the throne they are given."

1308.speaker: Manus Sazon
1308.text: "We will, Mother. And thank you, Your Majesty. Vina will be overjoyed."

1310.speaker: Player_Romus
1310.text: "I expect to hear only words of gratitude from House Sazon from now on. No complaints."

1312.speaker: Player_Romus
1312.text: "Your house has a long, proud history of supporting the Crown. We should not let the last 30 years get in the way of that."

1314.speaker: Player_Romus
1314.text: "All the administrative difficulties and culture clashes -- those are yours to deal with now."

1316.speaker: Leona Sazon
1316.text: "The only thing that would make our house happier is... well, never mind."
1316.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] > 5) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_ZpanaHydroelectricDam_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Welfare_SallabesSanctuaryExpansion_Project"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_SallabesConsumerIndustry_Completed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_RD_Economy_IzaHeavyIndustry_Completed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_MarriageDecision_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true) == false)

1321.speaker: Player_Romus
1321.text: "Let's not spoil this moment with more tedious requests. It's been a pleasure talking to you, Leona."

1322.speaker: Player_Romus
1322.text: "Out with it. What do you want?"

1323.speaker: Player_Romus
1323.text: "Leona. It would be my pleasure to reward House Sazon for the loyalty you have shown me these past years."

1329.speaker: Narrator
1329.text: She snuck a glance at Manus.

1330.speaker: Leona Sazon
1330.text: "I will only ask this once more, Your Majesty."

1331.speaker: Leona Sazon
1331.text: "Angelica Sazon still languishes in exile on Caleqabiz. Could you not imagine setting her free to walk on her home soil?"

1333.speaker: Player_Romus
1333.text: "What makes you think she even wants to return? That she doesn't still resent the Crown for punishing her?"

1343.speaker: Manus Sazon
1343.text: "I never would have expected this, Your Majesty. Your mercy is... surprising."
1343.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1344.speaker: Leona Sazon
1344.text: "As I said, I will not trouble you with this any further. You've done enough for the Sazons."

1345.speaker: Player_Romus
1345.text: "Our houses have had a long and harmonious history together. We shouldn't let the last 30 years spoil everything."

1346.speaker: Player_Romus
1346.text: "I am glad your house remembers its place. We wouldn't have to send you back to Caleqabiz, would we?"

1348.speaker: Player_Romus
1348.text: "Your congratulations are most accepted. Lucita and I are very happy."

1349.speaker: Player_Romus
1349.text: "I allowed Vina and Manus to marry for a reason. My new heir will not be an obstacle between them and the Rizian throne."

1350.speaker: Narrator
1350.text: She beamed with delight, then glanced suspiciously at Manus.

1353.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1353.text: "This is all assuming that the Rizian throne is something my son wants."

1354.speaker: Manus Sazon
1354.text: "I do, Mother. And Vina will be overjoyed."

1355.speaker: Leona Sazon
1355.text: "The King of Rizia bringing new life into the world is indeed something to celebrate."

1356.speaker: Narrator
1356.text: Leona smiled at me warmly, ignoring the looks of disappointment from Angelica and Manus.

1357.speaker: Player_Romus
1357.text: "Confidentially, I hope it's a girl. I wouldn't want anything to get in the way of Vina and Manus' inheritance."

1358.speaker: Leona Sazon
1358.text: "Nor would we, Your Majesty. But such things are up to the universe, not men."

1359.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1359.text: "On the other hand, Rizia's succession laws are man-made. With the emphasis on 'man'."

1366.speaker: Player_Romus
1366.text: "You and I are united by a common goal, Angelica. We both want grandchildren."

1369.speaker: Player_Romus
1369.text: "It's only a pity it didn't work out between my daughter and your son."

1375.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1375.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false)

1379.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1379.text: "That was hardly your fault, Your Majesty."
1379.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_SendToWar"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_DiesInWar"] == false) == false)

1383.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1383.text: "Those terrible Palesians. I hope she makes it home soon."

1385.speaker: Narrator
1385.text: Leona brought a handkerchief to her eye.

1386.speaker: Leona Sazon
1386.text: "Those boys on the front lines... Truly tragic."

1387.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1387.text: "To fight for Rizia the way he did took real courage. His father never would have done the same."

1391.speaker: Angelica Sazon
1391.text: "He surprised us all in the end, didn't he?"

1392.speaker: Leona Sazon
1392.text: "My own son's about to enter university. To think that could have been him..."

1393.speaker: Player_Romus
1393.text: "A Sazon's been dodging the draft? You need to get him into uniform immediately."

1394.speaker: Player_Romus
1394.text: "It's good that he's out of harm's way. Rizia's going to need bright young minds when the war is over."

1398.speaker: Player_Romus
1398.text: "My daughter is still missing. This conflict has brought death and destruction into all of our lives."

1399.speaker: Player_Romus
1399.text: "Don't worry, Countess. We will win before your son has to fight."

1401.speaker: Leona Sazon
1401.text: "I'll speak to him when I get home, Your Majesty. It may be difficult with classes in full swing."

1402.speaker: Leona Sazon
1402.text: "He's the brightest of them all, Your Majesty. Always eager to do his part."

1403.speaker: Leona Sazon
1403.text: "May it all be worth it in the end."

1404.speaker: Leona Sazon
1404.text: "I hope so. We're all supporting the war from afar."

1411.speaker: Player_Romus
1411.text: "As much as I'd love to keep talking to you, I have other guests to entertain."
1411.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_HouseSazon"] < 0) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_Hostage"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Manus_Gone"] == true) == false)

1412.speaker: Leona Sazon
1412.text: "Naturally. I'm sure the other houses are dying to speak with you as well."

1424.speaker: Narrator
1424.text: He glanced nervously at his mother. I wondered how much she suspected.

1425.speaker: Narrator
1425.text: As I extricated myself from House Sazon, I looked around at the remaining guests.
1425.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"]) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Path"] == true) == false)

1427.speaker: Player_Romus
1427.text: "She's even happier that House Sazon came to pay its respects."

1428.speaker: Leona Sazon
1428.text: "May our cooperation now herald a lasting peace in the years to come."

1429.speaker: Leona Sazon
1429.text: "They will all come around. What's the alternative?"

1430.speaker: Leona Sazon
1430.text: "Let's hope it doesn't come to that."

1431.speaker: Leona Sazon
1431.text: "I won't keep you any longer. But we will update you on our progress against the rebellion."

1439.speaker: Manus Sazon
1439.text: "Yes... I hope this was the right decision."

1440.speaker: Narrator
1440.text: As I extricated myself from House Sazon, I looked around at the remaining guests.
1440.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Angelica"]) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Invited_Manus"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Birthday_SazonsAgainstUnrest_ManusRefuses"] == false) == false)

1442.speaker: Narrator
1442.text: Leona looked me in the eye as she bowed.

1453.speaker: Manus Sazon
1453.text: "A family that should know by now that violence is not the answer."
